scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm -r --filter @tabdo/queue --filter @tabdo/storage typecheck && pnpm --filter @tabdo/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @tabdo/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @tabdo/server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @tabdo/client exec tsc -b --pretty false && pnpm --filter @tabdo/mcp exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm -r --filter @tabdo/queue --filter @tabdo/storage test && pnpm --filter @tabdo/ui test && pnpm --filter @tabdo/shared test && pnpm --filter @tabdo/client test && pnpm --filter @tabdo/server test
scripts.typecheck:test: pnpm build:foundation && pnpm -r --filter @tabdo/queue --filter @tabdo/storage typecheck:test && pnpm --filter @tabdo/shared typecheck:test && pnpm --filter @tabdo/server typecheck:test
